description.value: Blenz Coffee at Granville & Davie is a 24-hour location of the BC-based coffee chain, situated in Vancouver's busy Davie Village neighbourhood. The café serves espresso drinks, nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a broad food menu spanning breakfast items, pastries, sandwiches, wraps, and desserts. Its round-the-clock hours make it a dependable food and drink stop for cyclists arriving or departing at any hour.
